summary: This bill prohibits the United States from providing assistance to countries that vote against the U.S. position in the United Nations General Assembly or Security Council more than 50 percent of the time, with an exemption for countries that undergo a fundamental change in government and policy.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly prohibits U.S. assistance to countries that oppose the U.S. position in the United Nations, explicitly defining 'United States assistance' to include economic support, military education and training, and foreign military financing. This is the central purpose of the bill, aiming to reduce foreign aid to specific countries.
